Reviewed a BCA assessment report (ref. CF10606-RP02A-Stage 1-120613, dated 12 June 2013, by another consultant) and the DA architectural drawings listed in Table 1.
States the alternative solutions in Table 2 are variations from BCA 2013 deemed-to-satisfy provisions, to be formulated to meet the relevant performance requirements.

Table 2, basement car park: travel distance to a point of choice 25 m (DtS limit 20 m); travel to the nearest exit 70 m (DtS 40 m); between alternative exits 130 m (DtS 60 m); clauses D1.4 and D1.5 against DP4 and EP2.2.
Table 2 also lists a fire control centre not located at the front entrance (Specification E1.8; EP1.6) and residential-tower travel-distance items under clause D1.4.
